constraints: First validate actual virtual-display isolation while phone available; do not promise main-screen independence from docs alone.
Force exact test serial; create a new display only, never mirror/record primary display. No audio capture/clipboard sync/power changes.
Do not use no-vd-destroy-content: it would move app to physical main display on exit.
Pin IME to local virtual display and verify native dialogs stay there; stop any dialog that opens on physical display.
Clipboard and playback/audio remain shared-device behaviors; hold those tests while Owner actively uses phone.
Finish any active recording/receive/OTA before closing test display.
No new background service/login task installed; tool not launched because ADB is disconnected.
